summary: Implemented T11 incremental sync collection: added REPORT sync-collection handler with opaque HMAC-signed sync tokens, initial snapshot, incremental change paging, RFC 6578 deletion representation, and safe failure on invalid tokens. Added a resource_name column to the change log (migration 0026) so deleted changes carry their DAV href after the tombstone clears the event reference.
follow_up: The DAV delete path stamps the change-log resource_name after the domain delete (stamp_change_resource_name); a narrow race exists if a sync-collection reads between the delete commit and the stamp. Acceptable for now; could be tightened by moving the tombstone into the domain transaction (T09 design).
important_context: Change log (caldav_event_changes) now has a nullable resource_name column (migration 0026) carrying the DAV resource name for deleted changes.
Sync tokens are opaque base64url(revision).base64url(hmac) strings, signed with the SecretKey; clients must treat them as opaque and echo them back verbatim.
sync-collection REPORT is now dispatched in the calendar REPORT handler alongside calendar-query and calendar-multiget; sync-level must be 1.
Initial snapshot (empty sync-token) returns all exposed events plus a token at the latest revision; incremental calls page the change log by revision.
